scope: Local regression, stdio MCP/CLI and installed bundle verification. No model generation, Oracle work or billed-token measurement.
changes: Shorter skill entrypoints with conditional references; no repeated work startup in specialist skills.
Shorter 24-tool catalog; default arguments optional in MCP and packaged input schemas.
Bounded jobs.status waitSeconds 0..30 with immediate default, abortable waiting and no operation replay.
Corpus-revision scoped normalization cache for varied reference searches; unchanged result hashes.
Normal MCP output reuses its first serialization.
Single still runs directly in the user-opened Codex session.

checks.oneCallJobCompletion: Passed for real local fixture workers over both stdio entrypoints.

limitations: Byte reductions are not token or billing savings. Skill totals are aggregate entrypoints, not all loaded per task.
Retrieval timing is a local synthetic benchmark, not end-to-end editing latency or Oracle performance.
No end-to-end APEX task in a freshly loaded Codex desktop session.
publication: Local installation only; no commit, push, tag or registry publication.
